subject: redirect old shiny app website to new shinnyapps.io

messages.author: 26fecb150d87828f
messages.subject: redirect old shiny app website to new shinnyapps.io
parts:
Could someone put up instructions on how to redirect an old shiny app (now obsolete) web address to the new shinnyapps.io? I had published a scientific article about a webtool I created using the old shiny app, so I have to try to keep that address to make sure people can still link the publication to the webtool listed there. I already re-deployed the app in the new shinnyapps.io, but I don't know what to do now. 

Thanks, 

Veronica

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: redirect old shiny app website to new shinnyapps.io
parts:
You can use JavaScript to redirect a page, e.g. use this in your ui.R:

fluidPage(
tags$head(tags$script(HTML("window.location.replace('https://YourNewAppURL');")))
)

You can empty the rest of UI content and the server function of the old app.

Regards,
Yihui
